reviews.title: My uncle thanks you
reviews.text:
The bracket app completely transformed my family dynamic. What started as a simple round robin tournament ended up bringing our estranged family back together in ways I never imagined. Everyone, from the most competitive cousin to my uncle with a peg leg and some unique physical features, found a place in the fun. Seeing him earn second-to-last place and proudly claim his spot on the rankings was a moment we’ll all remember.

While the app was nearly perfect, I do think it could improve by factoring point differentials into the rankings. It would add a bit more fairness and excitement to close matches. That said, the ease of use, clarity, and ability to schedule games made it an unforgettable experience for all of us. This app didn’t just create a tournament—it created lasting memories and connections for my uncle.
